canvas.quick_add: Quick Add Node (Space or Right Click)

trigger_start.name: Start Command (/start)
trigger_start.desc: Fires when user presses /start or uses deep link / referral.

trigger_command.name: Custom Command
trigger_command.desc: Fires on slash commands (e.g. /help) and auto-syncs with Telegram menu.

trigger_callback.name: Button Click (Callback)
trigger_callback.desc: Fires when user clicks an inline keyboard button.

trigger_message.name: Message Received
trigger_message.desc: Fires on user text message or matching pattern.

action_send_message.name: Send Message / Media
action_send_message.desc: Sends text, photos, videos with styled buttons.

action_edit_message.name: Edit Message
action_edit_message.desc: Updates previous message content on callback.
action_edit_message.connected: Will edit the message sent by the connected node above.
action_edit_message.not_connected: Connect this node after a Send Message node to edit that message. Without text it will warn the user.

action_answer_callback.name: Answer Callback (Alert)
action_answer_callback.desc: Dismisses Telegram spinner and displays alert.

action_condition.name: Branch (If / Else)
action_condition.desc: Branches execution flow based on condition.

action_set_variable.name: Set User Variable
action_set_variable.desc: Stores dynamic user state in database.

math_add.name: Math: Add (+)
math_add.desc: Adds Input A and Input B, writes result to Output Variable.

math_subtract.name: Math: Subtract (-)
math_subtract.desc: Subtracts Input B from Input A, writes result to Output Variable.

math_multiply.name: Math: Multiply (*)
math_multiply.desc: Multiplies Input A by Input B, writes result to Output Variable.

math_divide.name: Math: Divide (/)
math_divide.desc: Divides Input A by Input B, writes result to Output Variable.

action_delay.name: Delay / Wait
action_delay.desc: Waits for specified seconds before proceeding.

action_http_request.name: HTTP Request / Webhook
action_http_request.desc: Sends GET or POST request to external APIs.

action_loop.name: Loop / Repeat
action_loop.desc: Repeats connected action N times with iteration index.

inspector.title: Node Inspector & Properties
inspector.no_selection_desc: Click any node on canvas to edit its properties.
